title: Zayn Malik's Daughter Khai Wants To Be A 'K-Pop Star', But He Isn't Happy | Hollywood News - News18
text: Seems like Zayn Malik’s daughter, Khai, wants to follow in her father’s footsteps, just in a different genre. The 33-year-old singer appeared on the latest episode of the Call Her Daddy podcast and opened up about parenting his five-year-old, whom he shares with his ex-girlfriend, supermodel Gigi Hadid. When host Alex Cooper asked Zayn what his daughter wants to be once she grows up, he revealed that she is very much interested in K-pop and would love to be a K-pop star. “She definitely wants to be a K-pop star. She’s big into K-pop," he said. The answer amused the host, and she further inquired about his feelings regarding his daughter’s wish. He mentioned that he is not too happy with the decision, and he has reasons for it. While Zayn Malik Wants To Keep Khai Away From K-pop, He Would Still Support Her “I’d like to keep her away from it, you know, but at the end of the day, if she’s happy … I’ll support her," the former One Direction member explained. His response prompted the host to say that Khai might call him a “hypocrite" if he ever told her not to be in a girl group or not be a part of the music industry. To this, Zayn replied, “Yeah, I won’t be able to say that." He admitted that he would have to support her if she decides to be a K-pop star, but if it’s up to him, he would keep her away. He mentioned, “I would like to keep her away from some of the headaches that this job entails." When Zayn Malik Thought A Collab With BLACKPINK’s Jisoo Was ‘Cool’ Because Of Khai This is not the first time the singer has opened up about his daughter’s interest in K-pop. When Zayn collaborated with BLACKPINK’s Jisoo on the single EYES CLOSED, he shared how his five-year-old played a crucial role in the decision to work with the K-pop idol. Speaking with BBC Radio 1, the singer said his daughter’s love for Jisoo strongly influenced his decision to take on the feature. “My daughter’s a massive fan. So when she asked to do the feature, I was like, yeah. My daughter’s gonna think I’m cool again. So I’ll definitely do that. I’m not out of the game yet," he said. What’s Next For Zayn Malik? Zayn is releasing his fifth solo album, Konnakol, on April 17 via Mercury Records/Island Records UK, and it is available for pre-order. Following the release, he will also kick off the Konnakol Tour on May 12 at the AO Arena in Manchester, England. He will take his tour across North America, South America, Mexico, and the United Kingdom, making this his first major tour since leaving One Direction in 2015.
